item.g:title: Yellow Viscose Silk Wedding Embroidery Saree
item.g:description: This stunning yellow viscose silk saree with intricate embroidery is the perfect choice for brides and wedding guests seeking elegance and tradition. Crafted for special occasions like weddings, receptions, and mehendi ceremonies, this unstitched saree comes with a matching blouse piece to create your dream bridal look. Why Brides Choose Yellow Viscose Silk Sarees Yellow viscose silk sarees are a popular choice for brides and wedding guests because they symbolize prosperity, joy, and new beginnings. The rich, lustrous fabric drapes beautifully, creating a regal silhouette that photographs exceptionally well. Viscose silk offers the luxurious feel of traditional silk with added durability, making it perfect for all-day wedding celebrations. The vibrant yellow hue complements various skin tones and stands out beautifully in wedding photography, ensuring you'll make a memorable impression on your special day. What Makes This Embroidery Saree Special The embroidery work on this saree showcases meticulous craftsmanship with detailed patterns that add texture and dimension to the fabric. Each stitch is carefully placed by skilled artisans, creating a harmonious blend of traditional techniques and contemporary design. The embroidery features a combination of zari, resham, and sometimes stone or mirror work, depending on the specific design. This attention to detail transforms the saree from beautiful to extraordinary, making it a true heirloom piece that can be passed down through generations while maintaining its elegance and charm. Perfect For These Occasions Weddings - As a bride, bridesmaid, or wedding guest, this saree will make you stand out with its vibrant color and exquisite craftsmanship. Receptions - The sophisticated embroidery and luxurious fabric make it ideal for evening wedding receptions where you want to make a statement. Mehendi & Sangeet - Perfect for pre-wedding celebrations where you can showcase your style while participating in traditional ceremonies. Engagement Parties - A beautiful choice for engagement celebrations or other formal family gatherings where ethnic wear is expected. How to Style This Yellow Saree To complete your bridal look, pair this yellow saree with traditional gold jewelry for a classic, regal appearance. Consider wearing statement earrings, a matha patti, and a set of bangles to enhance the embroidery work. For footwear, opt for embellished juttis or heels in gold or metallic shades. The unstitched blouse piece allows you to customize the neckline and sleeve style to suit your personal preference—consider a deep back or off-shoulder design for added glamour. Style your hair in a traditional bun with fresh flowers or wear it down with soft waves for a more contemporary look that still honors tradition. Saree Sizing, Care & Shipping Sizing: This is a 6.2-meter unstitched saree with a 0.8-meter blouse piece. Custom tailoring services are available upon request for an additional fee. Care: Dry clean only to preserve the embroidery and fabric quality. Store in a saree bag away from direct sunlight to maintain the color and fabric integrity. Shipping: Free U.S. shipping over $150. Standard shipping takes 7-10 business days via DHL/USPS/UPS to the United States with tracking provided. Frequently Asked Questions Q: Is this sareee suitable for a destination wedding?A: Absolutely! The viscose silk fabric is lightweight yet luxurious, making it comfortable for destination weddings while maintaining its elegant appearance. Q: Can I get the blouse stitched by LuxeMia?A: Yes, we offer professional stitching services for an additional fee. Our tailors will create a custom-fit blouse based on your measurements provided during checkout. Q: How does the color appear in real life compared to the photos?A: While we strive to show accurate colors, the shade may vary slightly due to lighting and screen settings. The actual saree has a rich, vibrant yellow hue with beautiful embroidery details. The LuxeMia Promise At LuxeMia, we're committed to bringing you authentic Indian ethnic wear with uncompromising quality and craftsmanship. Your satisfaction is our priority, and we stand behind every piece we create with our quality guarantee and excellent customer service. Color: Yellow

item.g:title: Maroon Silk Embroidery Lehenga Choli with Dupatta
item.g:description: Product Overview This Maroon lehenga choli in Silk is a perfect pick for your next festive celebration. Featuring beautiful embroidery work, this outfit brings together traditional craftsmanship and modern design. The premium Silk fabric offers a graceful drape and comfortable fit, making it ideal for all-day wear at festivals and cultural events.
